additional_info.subject: Case creation note from end customer
additional_info.body: Hello, In this charger we have en electrical problem. Indeed, as you can see in the photos, there is a burnt part above the motor disconnector QA1 ans the charger is not working actually (because the terminal detects a short-circuit and switches off at the electrical panel). I think you may need to change the burnt grid above QA1, the burnt copper busbar, and the screw that holds the tiller set. And maybe QA1. Please take note that we did not have any intervention on this charger since a long time. Please also take note that we have consigned the charger so if you do an intervention tell me the date so I can give you the keys of the padlock. Thank you,

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0407223-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312569868/13] QA1 Brunt CRM:01811000669
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Customer has reported that QA1 is burned. However, based on the three pictures provided, it is impossible to accurately assess the extent of the damage or determine the cause of the burn.
Given the limited information, I would kindly ask if someone from your team could visit the site to inspect the unit in person.
In the event that the motor is indeed impacted, we may need to assess if it overheated and, if required, replace it. Additionally, it would be prudent to inspect the Undervoltage Release device for any potential damage, and if found, replace it as well.
It is crucial that visit the site to fully inspect the situation. Please make sure to bring spare parts, including a copper bar and an MCCB(QA1), to be prepared for any necessary replacements.
MLFB No. :
QA1           - 3VA1463-6EF42-0AA0 -QA1
MCCB
4P In=630A Ir=441A-630A Icu=70kA
copper bar - 8EM5901-1AA02-2AA5
QA1           - 3VA9908-0BB1
Undervoltage Release
3VA 24VDC
MA1          -3VA9467-0HA20 -MA1 Motor Operator 230V 3VA 400A/630A.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it
